All primary flows PASS: (a) Dashboard renders 4 summary tiles (BATTERY AVG, TOTAL ATTEMPTS, MODULES TRIED, GAMEPAD/FULL HISTORY buttons) + 20 module cards with per-card AVG SCORE / BEST / ATTEMPTS or 'No attempts yet.' after seeding history. (b) Category color-header on each card + READY badge. (c) 'View Score History' navigates to /history/<module-id>. (d) Header nav (Dashboard, History, Gamepad, Admin) all navigate correctly with active-state highlighting. (e) /history all-modules shows Module column + summary tiles hist-total=4, hist-assessments=3, hist-avg=73.6%, hist-best=83.3% (from 3 Airborne Numerical seeded assessment attempts + 1 Visual Search practice) with sparkline SVG polyline. (f) /history/airborne-numerical filters correctly (no Module column, only that module stats). (g) Gamepad Calibration renders Live Preview + Controls, Status=NOT CONNECTED red, deadzone/sensitivity sliders, axis X/Y selects, invert checkboxes, Save/Reset/Back buttons; localStorage 'aviation_aptitude_gamepad' updated on Save. (h) Auditory Capacity full 3D scene renders (canvas 960x480, blue ball with radial gradient, yellow numbered checkpoint rings, perspective grid + sunset sky + radar minimap top-right, GATES/DIGITS/INPUT HUD, INPUT toggles KEYBOARD on ArrowRight). (i) All 20 modules reachable at /module/<id> and start Practice+Easy without any JS runtime errors. (j) Cognitive Updating begin-instruction-phase-btn triggers simulation. (k) Numerical Operations Enter key advances question (Q1->Q2). (l) Admin has 20 accordion toggles + Save + admin-gamepad-link.

integration_issues.flow: Dashboard BATTERY AVG when a module has only PRACTICE attempts
integration_issues.issue: getStats() returns a non-null stats object with avg=0 for modules that have attempts but no assessments (practice-only). This pulls the battery-avg down (observed 36.8% when one module had 3 assessments @ avg 73.6% and another had only 1 practice @ 30% -> counted as 0). Consider excluding modules with 0 assessments from allStats.avg calculation.

issues: Digit callout interval formula Math.max(1500, (testDuration*500)/sequenceLength) yields 30000ms (30s) between digits on Easy (240s / 4 digits). Callouts occupy only ~half the test time by design, but 30s gaps may feel too sparse for a memory-under-load task. Consider clamping to a max of ~5-8s or using a smaller multiplier.
Console shows benign DOM warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' caused by dev x-source instrumentation, not app code (not user-visible). No action required unless upgrading the tooling.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In Dashboard.js filter allStats to only modules with assessments>0 before averaging so practice-only modules don't drag BATTERY AVG down.
OPTIONAL: Tune AuditoryCapacity digit interval so callouts are 4-8s apart on Easy instead of 30s.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js: overallAvg averages modules that have 0 assessments (avg=0) if they have any practice attempt. Filter stats.assessments > 0 before averaging.

AuditoryCapacity.js: digit spawn uses `setInterval` inside `start()` and clears via a returned function that is never invoked (start is not a useEffect). The interval is only cleared naturally when `d >= c.sequenceLength`. On unmount before completion, timer keeps running (though speechSynthesis.cancel is invoked). Consider tracking `digitTimerRef` and clearing in unmount effect.
AuditoryCapacity.js: `speed` state is set via setSpeed inside RAF loop every frame -> excessive re-renders. Consider using a ref (speedRef) since UI never reads it, or throttle.
AuditoryCapacity.js: setBallPos, setCheckpoints, setGatesPassed/Missed are called every frame from RAF; this is a heavy render load. Move to refs and only setState at ~10Hz.
